# Literal flags as foreach() items, a list read by name, and outputs whose names CONF-11 cannot tell.
foreach(_opt -mavx2 -mfma)
  target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_opt})
endforeach()
foreach(_flag IN ITEMS -mavx2 -mfma)
  check_cxx_compiler_flag(${_flag} _tp_has_flag)
  if(_tp_has_flag)
    target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_flag})
  endif()
endforeach()
set(_tp_l -mavx2 -mfma)
list(POP_FRONT _tp_l _tp_first)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_first})
list(GET _tp_l 0 _tp_got)
target_compile_options(tp_volk PRIVATE ${_tp_got})
function(_tp_get_simd)
  cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "OUT" "" ${ARGN})
  set(${ARG_OUT} -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_flags prefix)
  set(${prefix}_FLAGS -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_argv)
  set(${ARGV0} -mavx2 -mfma PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()
function(_tp_fwd)
  cmake_parse_arguments(ARG "" "OUT" "" ${ARGN})
  helios_isa_avx2_flags(${ARG_OUT})
endfunction()
set(ENV{CXXFLAGS} "-mavx2 -mfma")
set(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILE_OBJECT "<CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER> -mavx2 <FLAGS> -o <OBJECT> -c <SOURCE>")
